data.long_meaning: Sejal in Sanskrit means ‘seashell’, which is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sajalam’. The name is associated with the sea, the beach, and the joy and happiness that comes with being near water. The name Sejal carries the meaning “Seashell” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Sejal usually hope their child will grow to embody seashell and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is believed that being near the sea can bring joy, peace, and cleansing. The name is also associated with the Hindu deity, Lord Varuna, who is the god of the seas and oceans.
